observations: Wall-mounted salon bonnet hair dryer with adjustable swing arm, mounted to a white wall.
Dome/hood is cream-colored with 'EQUATOR' branding visible on control panel in both photos.
Two round control knobs visible on the hood, no digital display.
Clear plastic bottom chamber (likely for the dryer's bonnet or diffuser storage) is visible, dark tinted.
Cables run from the hood to the wall mount; some wiring appears loose/exposed near the swivel joint.
No power cord, plug, or switch panel clearly visible.
No visible timer dial markings or heat settings readable.
Background shows a salon setting with mirror, decorative plant, and small cabinet with bottles (photo 1).

claims.evidence: Marketing statement; no way to confirm suitability or performance from photos alone.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the wiring junction and swivel joint.

Close-up photo of the power cord, plug, and switch/control panel.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Equator-branded wall-mounted salon bonnet hair dryer, but functional status, wiring safety, and completeness (cord/plug) are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working or uncertain-condition unit until proof is provided.
